RERUN_PLAN_WITH_ENHANCED_KEY_ROTATION.summary: Running classification on 8,356 rows (3,005 MISSING + 5,351 FAILED) using enhanced per-key credit tracking.
RERUN_PLAN_WITH_ENHANCED_KEY_ROTATION.enhancement: The script now intelligently skips API keys that have exhausted credits (HTTP 402 errors) and temporarily disables them, allowing other keys to continue working.

step_3_run_classification.title: Step 3: Run Classification with Enhanced Key Rotation
command: python social_classifier_parallelization.py both --input unprocessed_rerun.parquet 2>&1 | tee rerun_$(date +%Y%m%d_%H%M%S).log
parameters_details: - Process in chunks with your 20 API keys in parallel
- Rotate keys intelligently: when a key hits 402 (insufficient credits), it's marked as exhausted
- Skip exhausted keys and continue using others with available credits
- Every 5 minutes, re-test exhausted keys in case credits were refilled
- Perform 3-pass retry cascade for any failures (full batch, half batch, then individual)

step_4_monitor_progress.title: Step 4: Monitor & Interpret Logs
key_messages: ✅ 'API key …XXXXXX marked EXHAUSTED (402 credit limit)' — key hit credit limit, will be skipped
ℹ️ 'Re-enabling API key …XXXXXX (possible credit refill)' — retrying a previously exhausted key
🚨 'ALL API keys exhausted (402)' — all keys have hit limit; remaining rows will fail unless credits are refilled

causes: - All 20 keys have consumed their monthly credit budget
- API keys are invalid or corrupted (same as before with non-ASCII chars)
solution: 1. Check OpenRouter dashboard to confirm key balances
2. If budget exhausted, you need to refill credits (contact support or upgrade plan)
3. If keys are corrupted, verify OPENROUTER_API_KEYS env var has clean keys
4. Restart the script once credits are refilled

problem_checkpoints_causing_issues.symptom: Script resumes from old checkpoint and fails
problem_checkpoints_causing_issues.solution: Restart and always clear checkpoints first (Step 1)

problem_only_partial_rerun.symptom: Script only processes 100 rows instead of 8,356
causes: - processed_success.csv still exists and filters out rows
- Review IDs don't match between source and rerun file
solution: 2. If processed_success.csv shouldn't filter anything, clear it
3. Check that review_id column names match

outputs.processed_success.csv: Successfully classified rows (appended to existing if present)
outputs.processed_failed.csv: Rows that failed after all retries

key_features_of_enhancement.feature_1: Per-key exhaustion tracking — tracks which keys hit HTTP 402
key_features_of_enhancement.feature_2: Intelligent rotation — skips exhausted keys, uses available ones
key_features_of_enhancement.feature_3: Periodic re-enabling — retests exhausted keys every 5 minutes
key_features_of_enhancement.feature_4: Graceful degradation — if all keys exhausted, logs error and continues with permanent failures
key_features_of_enhancement.feature_5: Per-pass tracking — separate key_tracker for each retry phase (Pass 2, 3, 4)
